dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Welcome, dear guest. Nachtraben Airlines, at your service...

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Hmm? You know us not? Well now, allow me to make introduction.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: We Night Ravens have returned to the castle at our Prinzessin's behest. Yet, it is located on high, and reaching it has proven quite the ordeal. Thus has a path been made through the wind to our keep.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Naturally, it is not only for our use. You may make use of it as well... But you will require a Nightwatch Contract from Her Highness...

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Dear guest, might I ask if you have such a Nightwatch Contract in your possession?

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: If you do indeed wish to gain the right to access this vantage point, then please, produce your contract.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Ah, 'tis so, 'tis the Prinzessin's Nightwatch Contract!

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Behold, her elegant words and writing... Come, dear guest, allow me to grant you passage immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Welcome, dear guest, and thank you for choosing Nachtraben Airlines. Where do you wish to alight today?

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Of course. Step this way, and stay safe. We wish you an enjoyable trip.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Of course. Step this way, and stay safe. We wish you an enjoyable trip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need to go anywhere at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Certainly, dear guest. Should you require anything, you need only ask.
